incident-bot: PAGING: metering-telemetry high-latency + token-count drift detected in prod emitter (severity: P2) -- runbook: metering/telemetry > check-emitter, start-recon

alice (oncall): seeing a sudden jump in delayed usage reports, overage flags spiking for a subset of customers. page landed on my phone. I'm on it.

bob (eng-sre): I'm attaching a quick tail of the emitter logs, looks like ack backlog + repeated retries to billing pipeline.

bob (eng-sre): ```
2026-03-15T12:02:03Z ERROR emitter: failed send batch id=0x7f3 retries=5 err=timeout
2026-03-15T12:02:04Z WARN aggregator: token_count_delta mismatch expected=3243 observed=2701 key=batch-42
2026-03-15T12:02:06Z INFO emitter: queued to retry batch id=0x7f3
```

maria (billing): seeing deltas in downstream counts too. Some customers' dashboards show 0 tokens for a window, then a big catch-up later. Could be counting windowing + emitter replay ordering.

kevin (cs): CS already getting tickets from two customers in EU region about sudden usage spikes and emailed overage notices. We should hold outbound overage notifications while we triage.

alice (oncall): action plan draft: 1) mute overage alerts 2) throttle emitter retries 3) run immediate reconciler on last 6h 4) if drift > 5% for top 50 customers, notify CS & product. Assigning owners below.

sophie (product): +1 to muting notif. We need a concise customer-facing line if CS asks: "We've detected delayed usage reporting affecting recent billing displays; no charge adjustments will be applied while we reconcile."

luke (infra): I'm on throttle and will flip a rate limit on emitter to prevent retry storms. Command I'll run: `kubectl patch dc/emitter -p '{"spec":{"replicas":2}}'` and apply a 30s backoff via feature flag.

bob (eng-sre): I'll start the fast recon job `metering-recon --start=now-6h --top=500` and run a sampled audit comparing raw token events vs aggregated counts. If we find ordering replays, we'll do a targeted replay.

maria (billing): flagging the billing pipeline owners: if reconciler shows double-counts we must ensure invoices are not generated. I'll pause downstream billing job `billing-finalize` for the impacted windows. Marking owner: maria (billing).

deploy-bot: Deploy event: feature-flag revert for emitter-backoff rolled out to prod in us-west at 12:12:34Z (sha: abcd1234) :white_check_mark:

alice (oncall): quick findings after first 20m: emitter retry storm correlated with a flaky egress to the aggregator in eu-west. Observed a window where batches were partially accepted, causing partial ACKs and a later replay of the remaining tokens that caused observed token_count deltas.

bob (eng-sre): recon job started. Preliminary sample shows ~3.8% undercount for 12:00-12:20 window and a later compensating spike at 12:30. Most affected customers are small-mid customers on dedicated routing.

kevin (cs): drafting CS note for affected customers. Key ask: do not auto-send overage bills for transactions in 12:00-13:00 window. Can Billing pause invoice generation for that window?

maria (billing): pausing `billing-finalize` for 12:00-13:00 window now. Also adding a reconciliation hold flag to downstream so invoices containing those windows will be marked as pending.

alice (oncall): mitigation summary so far: - throttled emitter retries (luke) - muted overage alerts (maria) - paused finalize (maria) - started recon (bob) - CS note drafted (kevin) - product message ready (sophie)

sophie (product): propose proactive outreach to top 10 affected customers with estimated impact and ETA for reconciliation (~2-3h). I'll prepare template.

bob (eng-sre): recon progress: sampled 1200 batches, found ~28 batches with partial ACK + late replay. Plan: targeted replay for affected batches: `./replay_emitter.sh --batches 0x... --dry-run` then dry-run audit, then physical replay.

alice (oncall): estimate: recon + replay + billing re-run ~2.5 hours. Setting bridge for 30m check-ins.

kevin (cs): uploading draft: "We're investigating delayed / duplicate usage data for a subset of customers in EU region. We're pausing billing for the impacted window and will follow up with corrected usage by EOD." feedback welcome.

maria (billing): LGTM. Also adding billing QA checklist to verify final counts before resume.

luke (infra): after throttle there was reduced retry volume and collector latency dropped from 420ms p95 to 85ms p95. Looks stable so far.

bob (eng-sre): replay dry-run finished: no duplicates in dry-run mode, counters reconcile to expected. Scheduling actual replay in 10m with careful rate limit and monitoring hooks.

deploy-bot: Replay job queued: metering-replay-3311112222 (owner: bob).

alice (oncall): decision: run replay now, keep billing pause until reconciler marks window green. CS to hold outbound emails; product to prepare follow-up note.

kevin (cs): notified CS rotation and top customers. Holding outbound overage emails.

bob (eng-sre): replay started. Watching aggregator metrics and count diffs in real-time.

bob (eng-sre): replay complete. Reconciler results: aggregated counts now within 0.3% of expected for sampled set.

maria (billing): verified reconciled counts for top 100 customers. Clearing hold for billing-finalize for 12:00-13:00 window. Will run billing QA and then unpause.

sophie (product): drafting final customer message: short summary + apology + next steps + offer to review any billing questions.

alice (oncall): post-incident notes / action items: - root cause: emitter partial-ACK + retry storm due to flaky egress in eu-west - short-term fix: improved backoff and throttling (luke) - medium-term: change emitter semantics to idempotent batch ids + stronger ACK verification (bob) - billing: add reconciler gating before finalize (maria) - CS/product: templated communication + monitoring playbook (sophie/kevin)

kevin (cs): will coordinate outbound messages and track any outstanding customer escalations.

bob (eng-sre): creating follow-up ticket: MTR-4479 "Emitter: idempotent batch & ACK verification" assigned to eng-runtime.

maria (billing): logging estimated customer impact: ~72 customers saw transient incorrect usage display, 8 received overage flags (no invoices sent). We'll reconcile and reach out as needed.

alice (oncall): closing incident: emitter replay success and billing resumed at 14:40Z. Leaving ticket open for follow-up engineering work and runbook updates. Thanks all. :tada:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metering-telemetry (duration 2h38m). Postmortem ETA: 72h.
